model.name: Qwen 3.6 Max Preview
model.description: Compared with the previously released Qwen3-Max and Qwen3.6-Plus, this model features enhanced vibe coding abilities, more efficient coding agent execution, and significantly improved front-end development skills. Additionally, its long-tail knowledge retention has been further upgraded.

sources.title: Vercel AI Gateway public model list
sources.notes: Provider model id, name, release date, context window, modalities, capabilities and prices as published by an aggregator rather than by the model developer.
Provider model ids, context window, modalities, capabilities and prices from the Vercel AI Gateway public model list (GET /v1/models). Pricing values are converted from per-token to per-million.

provider.name: Vercel AI Gateway
provider.description: Vercel's unified AI Gateway: a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes to hundreds of third-party models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and other upstream providers; supports OIDC tokens and provider-specific BYOK keys.

authentication.notes: Either a Vercel OIDC token issued via the AI Gateway (Authorization: Bearer <oidc>), or a per-provider BYOK key (Authorization: Bearer <openai|anthropic|...>). The active provider is selected by the model id prefix.
